# RFC 9935 ML-KEM-768 PKCS#8 fixtures

These fixtures are copied verbatim from RFC 9935 Appendix C.1.2, "ML-KEM-768 Private Key Examples".

Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9935

Files:

- `ml_kem_768_seed.pem` — seed format, `[0]` primitive implicit OCTET STRING with seed `000102...3e3f`.
- `ml_kem_768_expanded.pem` — expandedKey format.
- `ml_kem_768_both.pem` — both format, containing the same seed and expandedKey.
